name: Priya Sharma
review: PetExpertz Clinic is truly amazing! Dr. Rajesh saved my Bruno's life during an emergency at 2 AM. The staff is incredibly caring and professional. Highly recommend this clinic to every pet owner!

name: Arjun Mehta
review: Best vet clinic in the region! My Luna was always terrified of vets but the team here made her feel so comfortable. The grooming services are absolutely top-notch.

name: Sunita Verma
review: Dr. Amit performed a complex surgery on my Max and the results were incredible. Professional team, modern equipment, and genuine love for animals. Couldn't be happier!

name: Rohit Kumar
review: Great experience overall. Buddy's vaccinations are always on schedule and the doctors explain everything patiently. Very affordable prices compared to other clinics in the area.

name: Kavita Patel
review: I've been bringing Milo here for 3 years now. Dr. Neha's nutrition advice has completely transformed his health. The boarding facility is clean, safe and excellent!
